title: 5G SA. SMF and UPF don't associate
body:
Hi,

I have a problem in the association of SMF with UPF after their configuration.

Open5gs (without UPF) runs in a VM with three interfaces (management, N2, N4), UPF runs in an other with three interfaces (management, N3, N4) and in a third VM runs UERANSIM, also with three interfaces (management, N2, N3).

While the UPF seems to be associated, the SMF seems to be trying to reconnect. 

Randomly, the association between them establishes and everything works fine for a while. Then, the SMF once again de-associates and tries to reconnect.

The SMF configuration is the following:
```
logger:
  file: /var/log/open5gs/smf.log
max: null
nrf:
  sbi:
  - addr:
    - 127.0.0.10
    - ::1
    port: 7777
parameter: null
pool: null
smf:
  dns:
  - 8.8.8.8
  - 8.8.4.4
  - 2001:4860:4860::8888
  - 2001:4860:4860::8844
  freeDiameter: /etc/freeDiameter/smf.conf
  gtpc:
  - addr: 127.0.0.4
  - addr: ::1
  gtpu:
  - addr: 127.0.0.4
  - addr: ::1
  mtu: 1400
  pfcp:
  - addr: 192.0.2.3
  sbi:
  - addr: 127.0.0.4
    port: 7777
  subnet:
  - addr: 10.45.0.1/16
    dev: ogstun
    dnn: internet
time: null
upf:
  pfcp:
  - addr: 192.0.2.4
    dnn: internet

```
The UPF configuration is the following:
```
logger:
  file: /var/log/open5gs/upf.log
max: null
parameter: null
pool: null
smf: null
time: null
upf:
  gtpu:
  - addr: 172.50.1.3
  pfcp:
  - addr: 192.0.2.4
  subnet:
  - addr: 10.45.0.1/16
    dev: ogstun
    dnn: internet
```
Whereas, the SMF log file:
```
Open5GS daemon v2.2.3

03/30 10:47:57.361: [gtp] INFO: gtp_server() [::1]:2123 (../lib/gtp/path.c:31)
```

And the UPF log file:

So, how can I make the connection between them stable?

Thank you in advance,
Dimitris
